observation_summary: IDUNA — HQ-SPEC-IAM-096 Apples implementation (golden documentation log streaming)
actions_taken: Implemented full HQ-SPEC-IAM-096 Apples spec in IDUNA. New apples table (append-only, FK to agents) with migrations including apples.write/read/admin permissions seeded. Added auth.AppleRecord type to internal/auth/agent.go. Extended IAMStore interface with AppendApple/ListApples/GetApple. MySQLStore implementation: AppendApple runs in a single transaction that inserts the row and emits ApplePublished to iam_event_stream. New internal/http/handlers/apples.go: POST /api/v1/apples (apples.write), GET /api/v1/apples (filterable by agent_id/source_repo/apple_type, limit), GET /api/v1/apples/{id} (full with body and metadata). Routes wired in main.go behind RequireAuth middleware; permission checks inside handler. Back Office admin UI: /admin/apples filterable ledger + /admin/apples/{id} detail view with markdown body as preformatted text and metadata JSON block; nav bar updated. 9 handler tests all pass, full go test ./... green.
notes: Loop-close validation (POST an Apple from the live endpoint) requires DB migration 202606020001_apples.sql to be applied first. All other checklist items from golden.md complete. The RSI cycle now has a complete paper trail: code changes in Git, Apple record in Iduna, ApplePublished event in iam_event_stream, visible in Back Office audit viewer and new /admin/apples ledger.
